releases.name: v2.8-rc.2 - Dapper Crab 🎩🦀
releases.body:
🛠️ Fixes & Improvements

  • Add a display setting that allows the notch to follow the active display
  • Fix artwork for streamed Apple Music tracks — @ludovickjankowski-web
  • Fix inline sneak peek when music live activity is off — @DavideSirico
  • Open Settings when app is reopened while running — @AcornElf
  • Improve album artwork processing efficiency — @ericrcwu001
  • Add option to hide the source app icon on album art — @SwastikTripathi
  • Migrate legacy non-notch heights to the supported minimum
  • Improved localization coverage and accuracy
  • Updated dependencies used by the project

👋 New Contributors

@AcornElf · @ludovickjankowski-web · @SwastikTripathi · @ericrcwu001

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, translations, testing, bug reports, and feedback to this release!
